If you're getting your holiday plans together today you can head over here to pick up Trans-Siberian Orchestra tickets for just $49.99 (usually $86.84)! The show is happening December 1st either at 3 PM or 7:30 PM. Discount tickets could sell out so if you're interested I highly recommend buying now.
"This year, multi-platinum rock group Trans-Siberian Orchestra (TSO) kicks off a monumental winter tour on November 13th. The tour marks a triple celebration: 20 years of their beloved rock opera "THE LOST CHRISTMAS EVE," reaching their 20 millionth concertgoer, and surpassing a phenomenal $20 million donated to charity.
TSO remains true to the vision of their late founder, Paul O’Neill, by being one of rock's most generous bands. This year, the band will surpass a staggering $20 million donated to charity, a testament to their ongoing commitment to philanthropy. This generosity is fueled by their tradition of donating at least $1 from every ticket sold. That means with their 20 millionth fan attending a show on this tour, TSO will be hitting not just a concert attendance record, but a charitable milestone as well.
TSO's music director and lead guitarist, Al Pitrelli said, “When I was working on Lost Christmas Eve with Paul O'Neill, we talked a lot about time. He said that losing money or things wasn't as bad as losing time. Material losses can be recovered, but you can never get time back. That's why he always thought it was never too late to change. Never too late for forgiveness. People can make things right, forgive each other, and reconnect. The Lost Christmas Eve is about that hope: it's never too late for any of us."
This year's tour marks the grand return of "THE LOST CHRISTMAS EVE" to the stage for the first time since 2013. Expect an all-new, dazzling spectacle packed with pyrotechnics, lasers, and the incredible storytelling synonymous with TSO. The celebration continues with a high-energy second set featuring the group's greatest hits and fan favorites.
"THE LOST CHRISTMAS EVE" is a product of the imagination of and based on TSO’s double-platinum CD of the same name. The plot is one that resonates with people deeply over the holiday season. Alone on Christmas Eve, a bitter old businessman wandered New York City. Once a rising star, he’d traded love, family, and joy for a life of solitude and regret. The tragic loss of his wife hardened his heart, pushing him away from his infant son and into decades of isolation. Then, a chance encounter with a mysterious girl led him to a life-altering phone call. His son, who he abandoned decades ago, was alive, a gentle soul caring for troubled newborns in a maternity ward. After seeking him out, the son gives a silent and forgiving gaze to his long-lost father. As they sit together, comforting innocent infants, a new reunited life together begins."
Enjoy!

Would you like to take your family out for a great night of learning and fun FOR FREE? Check out First Friday in downtown Phoenix! This Friday, June 7th, three fantastic museums will offer everyone free admission from 5-9 PM.

Click here to read what the Children's Museum of Phoenix wrote about Free Friday capacity limits and recommendations.
Next up is the Phoenix Art Museum. Four times a year they offer free admission on Frist Friday from 5-9 and 6/7 is one of the dates (also mark your calendar for 9/6 and 12/6)! They promise live music, art-making workshops, entertainment, and more. Tickets are usually $28 for adults and $18 for kids, but know that even on First Friday you'll have to pay for the Barbie special exhibit (click here to see the details).
Last but certainly not least on the list is the Heard Museum. This is a beautiful place with an incredible collection of American Indian Art and much more. For First Friday they promise quite a dance party (click here for the details) and I called to confirm that admission is free for all on 6/7 from 5-9 PM. Admission is usually $22.50 for adults and $9 for kids.
Enjoy!

posts.title: Don't Miss the Luke Airforce Base 15-Aircraft Flyover Friday Starting at 3:10 to Honor Covid-19 Responders! Check Out the Map!
posts.excerpt: This is AWESOME and definitely something we won't want to miss! Head over here to check out the flight path of the 15-aircraft flyover happening Friday, May…
posts.text:
This is AWESOME and definitely something we won't want to miss! Head over here to check out the flight path of the 15-aircraft flyover happening Friday, May 1st starting at 3:10 PM and lasting 50 minutes.
Check out the details:
"Luke Air Force Base, to include the 56th Fighter Wing and the 944th Fighter Wing, along with the Arizona National Guard 161st Air Refueling Wing will honor Arizona's front line COVID-19 responders with a community flyover May 1, 2020."We are honored to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all the healthcare workers, first responders, military members and other essential personnel who are working on the front lines to combat the coronavirus," said Brig. Gen. Todd Canterbury, 56th Fighter Wing commander. "We want everyone to be able to look up from their homes and enjoy the display of American airpower, resolve and pride while keeping frontline defenders in their hearts." A formation of 15 aircraft, including seven F-35A Lightning IIs and seven F-16 Fighting Falcons flying out of Luke Air Force Base and one KC-135 from the 161st ARW will begin the flyover at approximately 3:10 p.m. local and will last 50 minutes. The flight path will bring them through Buckeye, Luke Air Force Base, Litchfield Park, Surprise, Waddell, Goodyear, Tolleson, Phoenix Metro, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Scottsdale, Deer Valley, Glendale, Peoria, Sun City West, and El Mirage. Residents along the flight path can expect a few seconds of jet noise as the aircraft pass overhead. Residents in these areas will be able to see the flyover from the safety of their homes and should maintain all social distancing guidelines during this event. They should also refrain from traveling to landmarks, hospitals and gathering in large groups to view the flyover. We welcome and encourage viewers to tag us on social media in photos and videos of the formation with the hashtag #LukeSalutes, #AirForceSalutes, and #FlyoverFriday. For questions, please call the Luke AFB Public Affairs Office at (623) 856-6011."
Thanks David!

posts.title: McDonalds is Giving Healthcare Workers and First Responders a Free Meal Each Day Through May 5th With ID!
posts.excerpt: McDonalds is recognizing the first responders and healthcare workers that are keeping us as healthy as possible during this crazy time. Through May 5th they…
posts.text:
McDonalds is recognizing the first responders and healthcare workers that are keeping us as healthy as possible during this crazy time. Through May 5th they can stop in for a free breakfast, lunch, or dinner (one meal per day). Head over here for all of the details.
"Thank You meal Frequently Asked Questions
What’s included in a McDonald’s Thank You meal?
During breakfast hours, first responders and healthcare workers can choose from an Egg McMuffin®, Chicken McGriddles® or a Bacon, Egg and Cheese Biscuit. All of these options also come with any size soft drink, tea or hot coffee and Hash Browns.
In the afternoon and evening, first responders and healthcare workers will have the choice of a Double Cheeseburger, 6 Piece McNuggets® or a Filet-O-Fish®. All of these options also come with any size soft drink, tea or hot coffee and small World Famous Fries®. Choices may vary by restaurant.
Who qualifies to receive a McDonald’s Thank You meal?
First responders and healthcare workers can receive their free Thank You meal via carry out and drive thru at participating McDonald’s restaurants by simply showing a work badge.
How can qualified individuals get a McDonald’s Thank You meal? Is it available nationally?
First responders and healthcare workers can get a Thank You meal by showing their work badge in the drive thru or through carry out at participating restaurants.
Is the McDonald’s Thank You meal available on McDelivery® through Uber Eats or DoorDash?
The Thank You meal is not available through McDelivery®. First responders and healthcare workers can receive their free Thank You meal via carry out and drive thru at participating McDonald’s restaurants by simply showing a work badge.
Is the McDonald’s Thank You meal be available for Mobile Order and Pay?
McDonald’s Thank You meal is not available through Mobile Order and Pay on the McDonald’s Global Mobile App. First responders and healthcare workers can visit a participating McDonald’s restaurant to redeem their free Thank You meal by presenting their work badge at the drive thru window or during carry out.
How long will McDonald’s be distributing Thank You meals?
Participating McDonald’s in the US are distributing Thank You meals to first responders and healthcare workers with a work badge beginning Wednesday, April 22 through Tuesday, May 5.
How much does a McDonald’s Thank You meal cost?
McDonald’s Thank You meals are free of charge for first responders and healthcare workers. Qualified individuals can redeem their free Thank You meal by showing their work badge via carry out or drive thru at participating McDonald’s restaurants nationwide.
How many Thank you meals can be given to each customer?
First responders and healthcare workers can enjoy one (1) Thank You meal per qualified customer per day. Qualified recipients include those first responders and healthcare workers and who show their work badge at carry out and drive thru at participating locations nationwide.
Are qualified recipients allowed to customize their McDonald’s Thank You meal?
Thank You meal choices cannot be substituted or customized at this time. First responders and healthcare workers will be able to choose from several meal options.
Thank You meal breakfast options include an Egg McMuffin® meal, Chicken McGriddles® meal or a Bacon, Egg and Cheese Biscuit meal. All of these options also come with any size soft drink, tea or hot coffee and Hash Browns.
McDonald's is also offering three Thank You meal lunch/dinner options – Double Cheeseburger meal, 6 Piece McNuggets® meal or a Filet-O-Fish® meal. All of these options also come with any size soft drink, tea or hot coffee and small World Famous Fries®.
How often can qualified recipients receive a Thank You meal?
Qualified recipients may redeem one (1) free Thank You meal per person, per day, upon showing their badge when ordering McDonald’s for carry out or in the drive thru.
Is there a toy included in the Thank You meal?
Rather than including a toy, each Thank You meal box will include a dedicated thank you note to first responders and healthcare workers, as a way to show our appreciation for everything they are doing to keep our communities safe during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Are Thank You meals available all day?
Beginning Wednesday, April 22 through Tuesday, May 5, first responders and healthcare workers who show a work badge will be able to receive their free Thank You meal at participating McDonald’s restaurants during their current normal business hours."
Enjoy!

Stay for up to six guests with daily passes to a huge indoor water park and access to kid-friendly activities and nine restaurants

Travel Dates
Book to stay between November 21 and February 13.
Prices vary by day; the price listed is the lowest possible and may not be available all days.
Click on a date on the booking calendar to see the individual prices by day.

Daily water park passes for each registered guest, up to the maximum room occupancy, are included in all options.
See additional details regarding room occupancy, water park passes, and more on the Fine Print & Details tab above. See FAQs here.
Property at a Glance: Great Wolf Lodge Scottsdale
The heart and soul of Great Wolf Lodge Scottsdale is its gigantic indoor water park. Splashy rides such as Alberta Falls—a four-story double-raft water slide—and a zero-depth-entry wave pool with 3-foot swells surround the park’s iconic hub: a four-story treehouse with a 1,000-gallon tipping bucket. Younger kids will have a blast with the water slides and gentle spray features of Whooping Hollow and Cub Paw Pool.
The water park, which hovers around 84 degrees all year long, isn’t the resort’s only family-friendly activity. You’ll also find an arcade with more than 100 games and mini bowling at Ten Paw Alley.
Extended water park access: You can enter the water park at 1 p.m. on the day you check in and stay until close on the day you check out (essentially 2 days’ water park admission).
Family-friendly fun: There are plenty of games and activities for kids of all ages. Explore all activities by age group here.
Hands-on crafts and activities such as face painting and balloon twisting during the Lunch Time Lineup can entertain young children when they want a break from the water park action.
Roomy suites comfortably sleep up to six people. The Wolf Den suite provides extra privacy with enclosed bunk beds.
Where to eat: There are nine restaurants and snack bars.
Add a Paw Pass or Pup Pass to your stay to enjoy kid-friendly activities and sweets at Creation Station, MagiQuest, and more at a discounted rate. See everything that’s included—as well as other available packages—here (additional fees apply).
Safety first: Complimentary life jackets in multiple sizes and trained lifeguards help keep families safe and secure.
Distance from Scottsdale: 6 miles
Our best tips on how to avoid crowds, dine on a budget, and dress down at Great Wolf Lodge
What You Get
Stay for six in a Family Suite or Wolf Den Suite, seven in a KidCabin suite, or eight in a Grizzly Bear Suite
Daily water park wristbands for each guest up to maximum occupants per room type
May have the maximum number of guests in room option purchased for no additional fee
Policies and Fees
Reservations: Dates cannot be changed through Groupon once booked; valid only for night(s) purchased.
Cancellation policy: 9-day cancellation notice required prior to check-in or reservation is non-refundable; reservations made within cancellation window are non-refundable.
Change policy: A nonrefundable $15 fee will be added to your reservation each time you contact the Great Wolf Lodge call center to change your reservation.
Additional fees: $29.99 daily resort fee plus tax added at purchase. 3% daily sustainability fee added at purchase.
Rates may vary by date and are subject to availability.
No-shows will be charged total rate; no refunds, rescheduling, or rebooking allowed.

Indoor water park and pool
Unlimited WiFi
Mini golf and mini bowling
Climbing wall
Nightly story time with costumed characters
Northwoods Friends Show in resort’s Grand Lobby (morning and evening)
Indoor ropes course
Arcade
Toy creation station
Nine dining options
Clothing and candy stores
Mini refrigerators in all rooms
Fitness center"

Don't forget that we can all head over here to get around half off tickets to Ballet Arizona’s version of The Nutcracker on Goldstar. Seats are available for $23-$80 plus fees, usually $45-$159 plus fees.
I would book early to make sure you get the date you want (for a deal)! We love going to this every year, it really is a magical experience.
“The New York Times called Ballet Arizona’s production of Ib Anderson’s The Nutcracker “one of the three finest” in the country. Lovers of ballet, lovers of the holidays or simply lovers of pure, thrilling spectacle flock each year to this Tchaikovsky classic. Filled with enchanted toys, mischievous mice and sugar plum fairies, the tale of Clara and her magical Nutcracker Prince has enraptured generations of children and adults. Now Ballet Arizona returns with its traditional yet dynamic version of The Nutcracker, which is charged with the stunning choreography of Ib Andersen, the company’s acclaimed artistic director, and accompanied by the Phoenix Symphony. Create a new holiday tradition — or relive memories of holidays past — with Tchaikovsky’s immortal The Nutcracker.:
I’m pretty excited about the new Easy Cancel option on Goldstar too!
“Frequently Asked Questions
What is Easy Cancel?
It’s one of the perks that comes along with buying tickets on Goldstar. It allows you to exchange your current date for another date or pick a new event entirely. These options are available to you as long as the offer (date/time) you purchased is still on sale on our site or app. If you choose to use Easy Cancel, you’ll get Goldstar store credit in the amount of your purchase. Goldstar credit includes the ticket prices as well as any service fees.
How do I use Easy Cancel?
You can start the exchange or credit process by clicking the Use Easy Cancel button on the My Tickets page. From there you just choose the number of tickets you want to cancel and select “confirm.”
How do I know if the offer I purchased is still on sale so I can cancel my tickets?
On your My Tickets page, under the “Need to Change Your Date” section, you’ll see the date and time the offer is set to expire. The offer expiration date/time is set in advance by the ticket supplier and it typically does not change after it’s been set. However, the ticket supplier can close sales early, and occasionally they choose to do so. It’s always best to view the offer expiration date/time at the time you receive your gift or complete your purchase. If you are considering using Easy Cancel, the sooner you can make your decision, the better. If the offer you purchased hasn’t yet expired, you can change dates or get credit for your tickets. If the offer has expired, you will see a message saying that tickets are no longer cancellable.
Will Easy Cancel cost me anything?
No. It is one of the perks of buying on Goldstar, and you get Goldstar credit for both the ticket price and service fees.
What is Goldstar credit? Where does my credited money go?
If you use Easy Cancel, the full value becomes credit on your Goldstar account. This credit never expires and can be used for any purchase on Goldstar. The credit will appear automatically during the checkout process when you make your next purchase. You can see your credit balance on the left side of your Account.
I bought a ticket for a friend who can’t go to the event. Can I get a partial credit?
Yes, with Easy Cancel you can cancel some or all of your tickets for Goldstar credit, as long as the offer (date/time) you purchased is still on sale on our site and app. Just select the number of tickets you would like to return, and you will receive a full Goldstar credit for those tickets and service fees.
Why can’t I use Easy Cancel on every purchase?
You can no longer use Easy Cancel after the offer you purchased has expired because at that point, sales have closed and the will-call list has been sent to the supplier. Once the supplier has received the will-call list, they must be paid for every ticket, so cancellations are not possible. Occasionally, offers may expire earlier than expected due to a supplier request to close sales. Also, there are a very small number of events for which cancellations are never allowed. These special instances are identified before you get to the purchase process so there are no surprises.”
I love this!
Enjoy!

"Valid for the following dates:
August 14–September 30, 2018
October 1–November 18, 2018
Kids frolic among exhibits designed to foster creativity and skill development in babies to 10-year-olds.
Members and children younger than 1 are regularly admitted for free.
About Children's Museum of Phoenix
Although classrooms can be vibrant centers for learning, they’re usually stocked with pencils and notebooks instead of a forest of suspended green noodles or a flying bathtub with wings. At the Children's Museum of Phoenix, both of these engage young minds alongside other hands-on exhibitsthat have earned the museum a glut of awards, including a place among Parents magazine’s 10 Best Children’s Museums in 2011. The museum fosters creativity and skill development in children from birth to age 10 with open-ended play activities that range from bouncing orbs in the Grand Ballroom to building forts with a wealth of safe construction materials, instead of mom’s favorite sheets and a nail gun. Perhaps the most eye-catching feature of the museum can be found in the atrium, where the Schuff-Perini Climber soars high into the air. Created from standard building materials, found objects, and out-of-context items such as its flying bathtub, the structure entices youths and inspires their imaginations. Another impressive contraption makes up the Whoosh! exhibit, where children feed scarves into a jumble of tubes that suck the fabrics up to heights of 20 feet before spitting them out to float gently down and be caught in waiting fingers. At each of these exhibits, a baby zone keeps the tiniest museum-goers safe, and they can find a space especially for them in the Place for Threes & Younger.
Children's Museum of Phoenix
Company Website"

Then look for the deal that will get two people into the Children's Museum of Phoenix for $12 (usually $24). With promo code FAMILY20 at checkout you'll pay just $9.60!
"About Children's Museum of Phoenix
Although classrooms can be vibrant centers for learning, they’re usually stocked with pencils and notebooks instead of a forest of suspended green noodles or a flying bathtub with wings. At the Children's Museum of Phoenix, both of these engage young minds alongside other hands-on exhibitsthat have earned the museum a glut of awards, including a place among Parents magazine’s 10 Best Children’s Museums in 2011. The museum fosters creativity and skill development in children from birth to age 10 with open-ended play activities that range from bouncing orbs in the Grand Ballroom to building forts with a wealth of safe construction materials, instead of mom’s favorite sheets and a nail gun.
Perhaps the most eye-catching feature of the museum can be found in the atrium, where the Schuff-Perini Climber soars high into the air. Created from standard building materials, found objects, and out-of-context items such as its flying bathtub, the structure entices youths and inspires their imaginations. Another impressive contraption makes up the Whoosh! exhibit, where children feed scarves into a jumble of tubes that suck the fabrics up to heights of 20 feet before spitting them out to float gently down and be caught in waiting fingers. At each of these exhibits, a baby zone keeps the tiniest museum-goers safe, and they can find a space especially for them in the Place for Threes & Younger.
What You'll Get
Choice of:
Children’s Museum Visit for Two, Valid August 15–September 30, 2017
Children’s Museum Visit for Two, Valid October 1–November 20, 2017
Kids frolic among exhibits designed to foster creativity and skill development in babies to 10-year-olds. Members and children younger than 1 are regularly admitted for free.

Not valid for special events, during annual closure (October 23-30, 2017) or during any day that the Museum is closed for special event set up. Cannot be redeemed for cash or gift cards. "The Hall of Flame Fire Museum showcases the history of firefighting with nearly an acre's worth of exhibits and restored pieces of firefighting equipment that date as far back as 1725. Visitors can check out a Rhode Island fire engine from 1844 that was capable of pumping 250 gallons of water per minute to put out fires or 250 gallons of sarsaparilla per minute to fuel citywide block parties. The Hall's 400 fire helmet collection presents 400 protective headpieces from around the world, and in the museum's sixth gallery, the National Firefighting Hall of Heroes honors firefighters who were decorated for heroism and those who have died in the line of duty."

"In 1966, Big Surf Waterpark founder Phil Dexter built his first model of a wave machine in his backyard, a place he affectionally named Tahiti Phil's. With some help, and several models later, he perfected the contraption, making it the centerpiece of his newly opened waterpark in 1969. Dexter's invention instantly snagged press from Time, Sports Illustrated, and Life, and today, it remains Big Surf Waterpark's 2.5-million-gallon keynote attraction. Over the years, despite Arizona's lack of rain, the park has managed to grow around the wave pool, and its current 20-acre campus features dozens of slides, rides, and areas for all ages. posts.text:
Spring Break is already here for some valley kids and it's close for many others! The Pogo Pass will help your family get out and have fun at places throughout the valley for the ENTIRE YEAR (including spring break). You can head over here to get one for $49.98, usually $124.95 with code ALICIA. If you've been following my blog for awhile, you already know that the Pogo Pass is the #1 Alicia's Deal of all time and I hear from so many readers how much fun their families have with it. Pogo Pass is A+ rated with the better business bureau.
They have added new venues to make the passes an even better value (the venues change from time to time and the value is incredible). Check out what's new with your pass:  Ice Den Scottsdale/Chandler: One free skate per month during regularly scheduled public skate times. This is usually $9 for adults, skate rental is not included.  Wazees World in Peoria: Two visits per year. Choose laser tag (usually $9) or cosmic golf (usually $5).  ASU Sun Devil Athletics: Now you can get into ASU Baseball games, gymnastics meets, soccer games, women's basketball games, volleyball games, track and field meets, select softball games, and more with your pass. There are so many games to choose from and this is perfect for the budding sports star who would love to play in college (or for anyone who likes to watch sports)! Places you can still use your passes (subject to change):  Phoenix Zoo: You'll enjoy two admissions per year. Since each admission for adults is usually $24.95, this will pay for your pass by itself!  Sunsplash: You'll enjoy one general admission to Sunsplash. This is usually $35.99!  Arizona Diamondbacks: You'll enjoy seats at two select Arizona Diamondbacks games per year. Choose from Saturday, May 13 vs. Pittsburg Pirates 5:10 PM, Friday, June 23 vs. Philadelphia Phillies 6:40 PM, Friday, July 21 vs. Washington Nationals 6:40 PM, Monday, August 14 vs. Houston Astros 6:40 PM, or Friday, September 22 vs. Miami Marlins 6:40 PM. *The registration button for tickets will appear on this page (2) weeks prior to game day, and close 48 hours prior to the event to allow for tickets to be generated. You must register your Pogo Pass to receive a ticket. Tickets for the Dbacks games are picked up at will call on game day.  AZ Airtime: Two (2) visits to AZ Air Time for a One (1) hour jump session. Visits can be used at either of the two locations. Simply present your Pogo Pass at front desk for admission. One hour is usually $14, good Monday-Friday but holidays and special offers excluded (you may want to call ahead before you make a special trip). Must have non slip socks. Phoenix Rock Gym: You'll enjoy two admissions per year. Normal price is $15, gear is available to rent for $5. Skateland: Passholders will get 2 visits a month (skate rental not included)! This is good during normal business hours. Family skate is usually $7.50/person. Fat Cats: Passholders will get one game of glow golf per week and one game of bowling per month (shoe rental not included). The IDEA Museum: Passholders will get two visits to the museum (must be used by the passholder on different days). Admission is usually $8. Arizona Rattlers: *One (1) ticket per game for Three (3) Arizona Rattlers home games. Saturday, March 11 vs Colorado Crush 6:00 PM, Saturday, April 22 vs. Spokane Empire 6:00 PM, or Saturday, May 20 vs. Salt Lake Screaming Eagles 6:00 PM. *The registration button for tickets will appear on this page (2) weeks prior to game day, and close 48 hours prior to the event to allow for tickets to be generated. You must register your Pogo Pass to receive a ticket. Tickets for the Rattlers games are electronic, and will arrive via email in the days leading up to the game. Phoenix Mercury: *One (1) ticket per game, for Three (3) Phoenix Mercury home games. Saturday, May 27th vs. Dallas Wings 7:00 PM, Friday, June 30th vs. Minnesota Lynx 7:00 PM, Friday, July 14th vs. Minnesota Lynx 7:00 PM, or Thursday, Aug 24th vs. LA Sparks 6:00 PM. *The registration button for tickets will appear on this page (2) weeks prior to game day, and close 48 hoursprior to the event to allow for tickets to be generated. You must register your Pogo Pass to receive a ticket. Tickets for the Mercury games are electronic, and will arrive via email in the days leading up to the game. Tempe Paintball: *Each Pogo Pass member can attend (1) Visit to Tempe Paintball per month for Paintball or Nerf Wars. Reservations are required for both Paintball and Nerf Wars. Enchanted Island: Your Pogo Pass is good for two (2) visits to Enchanted Island Amusement Park for an All-Day Ride Pass. Admission to the park is free. Limited capacity, first come first serve. Some rides may require additional charge. An all day ride pass is usually $18.75. Stratum Laser Tag: Pogo Pass holders can attend Stratum Laser Tag two (2) separate times, Pogo Passes may be used on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays from 4:30-8pm. Regular price for one game is $9.99. COMING SOON: Urban Jungle Fun Park Things to know about the Pogo Pass: You can renew each year at a discounted rate and you'll automatically get the available venues for another year (they'll contact you a couple of weeks before your pass expires and let them know if you choose not to renew). Venues may change and passholders will be notified. As new venues are added, your pass will automatically include them. Each person in the family needs their own pass. You can do a fundraiser with Pogo Pass and make extra cash for your organization! Contact me at alicia@dealsinaz.com for more information. These will hopefully get you out and having more fun in our valley of the sun! Enjoy!

posts.text:
Head over here to score a summer family pass to the Arizona Science Center for $34 with promo code SUMMER15 (a $100 value)! To give y ou an idea two adult tickets and two childrens tickets to the Arizona Science Center would cost you $57.80 to go once without the Grossology tickets. This is a far better deal and you can go all summer long!
Check out the info:
"Looking for something fun to do this summer? Keep that spark of curiosity burning brightly at Arizona Science Center, where -- during the summer only -- kids can learn the science behind "Grossology: The (Impolite) Science of the Human Body." While exploring interactive challenges, visitors will come face-to-face with the science behind various bodily functions and medical conditions.
• $40 ($100 value) for a Summer Family Pass for 4 people (valid May 25 to Sept. 7)
• Includes 2 tickets to "Grossology: The (Impolite) Science of the Human Body"exhibition
• Check the schedule for exciting live demos, which change daily
On a Mission to Inspire, Educate & Engage!
This Washington Street exploration station is open daily and packs four levels of interactive exhibits with more than 300 hands-on activities. You and your family will learn about the solar system, compare different brains, and experience a high-wire physics lesson -- and that's just scratching the surface. Located in the Sybil B. Harrington Galleries, "Grossology: The (Impolite) Science of the Human Body," runs through Monday, September 7. The exhibition lets kids get their hands dirty while discovering all the biological reasons behind things like runny noses, body odor, and more unappealing bodily functions. They'll be totally grossed out as they explore hands-on, interactive elements -- like becoming a dust particle to learn about sneezing, pumping soda into a cartoon character to understand burps, and sliding through the digestive system to see what it all looks like from the inside out."
Enjoy!

"Immerse yourself in the sights and sounds of the South Pacific as you experience the power and majesty of tigers like never before at the newly opened Tiger Trail. As you stroll through the rest of the park, be sure to catch Cheetah Run, where you'll see the fastest land animal show off his speed. You can also get up close with the animals at Lemur Walk. I absolutely love this place, especially the safari, but keep in mind that it can get toasty in the summer.

Download the Circle K app. After every home game you'll get a deal based on the "strike-outs"! Check out the "deals" in the menu at the top of the app. Today (4/8) you can get a free cookie, brownie, or slice with your app (no purchase required).
The kids and I took Great Grandpa to opening day and had a blast! We are excited for lots of fun games this season.
